definitions.title: The Definite Integral
definitions.statement: If f is defined on [a, b] and the limit of Riemann sums exists for every partition whose norm approaches 0 regardless of sample point choice, f is integrable on [a, b] and the limit is called the definite integral.
definitions.explanation: Every continuous function on a closed interval [a, b] is Riemann integrable.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Continuous functions are guaranteed to be integrable.

definitions.title: Algebraic Properties of Definite Integrals
definitions.latex: \int_a^b (k_1 f + k_2 g) dx = k_1 \int_a^b f dx + k_2 \int_a^b g dx, \quad \int_a^b f dx = \int_a^c f dx + \int_c^b f dx
definitions.statement: Definite integrals satisfy linearity, interval additivity, reversing limits sign reversal (int_b^a f = - int_a^b f), and domination (f <= g implies int f <= int g).
conditions: Integrands are integrable on relevant intervals
definitions.explanation: These properties allow decomposition of complicated regions into simpler geometric components.
definitions.keyTakeaway: The integral operator is linear and additive across subintervals.
